name: Adnan
tagline: Software QA | Automation & Applied AI | Traveler
seoDescription: Adnan Abir is a Software QA Working Student at Secusmart in Germany and an Infotronic Systems Engineering student at Hochschule Rhein-Waal. His work focuses on manual and functional testing, release validation and QA documentation. He is developing automation and API testing skills, practices applied AI, and runs the travel blog The Broken Backpack.
heroDescription:
I test, build, explore—and occasionally get lost on purpose.

I enjoy finding what breaks, building what helps, and exploring what comes next—both in technology and beyond the map.
bio: I’m an Infotronics Engineering student at Hochschule Rhein-Waal and currently work as a Software QA Working Student at BlackBerry.

In my professional role, I contribute to software quality by testing features, identifying issues, working with test cases, and supporting reliable development processes. This experience has strengthened my attention to detail and taught me that great software is not only about how it works—but also how consistently and securely it performs.

Beyond QA, I’m deeply interested in artificial intelligence, automation, and software development. I enjoy experimenting with AI-assisted workflows, building practical projects, and continuously expanding my technical skills.

Outside technology, travelling is an important part of who I am. Discovering new places, people, and perspectives keeps me curious—and that same curiosity shapes the way I learn, solve problems, and approach my work.
contactText: I’m always open to conversations around quality engineering, AI, software, and ambitious ideas. Whether you’d like to collaborate, discuss a project, exchange knowledge, or simply connect, my inbox is always open.
